legendPosition.description:
Position of the legend.

If the number of legend items is greater than 3, the legend position will
always be 'BELOW_CHART'

legendHorizontalAlignment.description: If the {@link legendPosition} is configured to be 'WITHIN_PLOT_AREA', how to align it horizontally.

legendVerticalAlignment.description: If {@link legendPosition} is configured to be 'WITHIN_PLOT_AREA', how to align it vertically.

legendLayout.description: If the legend is configured to be 'WITHIN_PLOT_AREA', how to layout the items in the legend.
